name: kouro
description: A programmable, deterministic execution engine for Agent Development Workflows

scripts.release:check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build:cli && bun run --cwd packages/web build
scripts.release:forgejo: bun run release:check && bun run scripts/publish-packages.ts forgejo
scripts.release:forgejo:dry-run: bun run release:check && bun run scripts/publish-packages.ts forgejo --dry-run
scripts.release:github: bun run release:check && bun run scripts/publish-packages.ts github
scripts.release:github:dry-run: bun run release:check && bun run scripts/publish-packages.ts github --dry-run
scripts.release:npm: bun run release:check && bun run scripts/publish-packages.ts npm
scripts.release:npm:dry-run: bun run release:check && bun run scripts/publish-packages.ts npm --dry-run
